approach: Extract run_module's inline write ladder into server/write_ladder.py and reuse it; put the write spine in a new server/filing/ package run by a FILING_ROLE worker so the CP3 read spine and its no-write tests stay untouched; drive FieldWorks' ParseFiler headlessly with a paused real IdleQueue and a fresh filer per word, enforcing the confirmed deletion projection as a per-word guard.

decisions.decision: Deletion bound uses FR-011 two conjuncts (user noopinion AND not in any segment), not CP3 projection predicate
decisions.why: ParseFiler deletes human-made never-evaluated unused analyses; CP3 is_human_record filter under-counts them, breaking FR-014
decisions.rejected: Reuse signals/projections.deletion_projection as-is

decisions.decision: Enforce the upper bound per word at filing time: skip a word whose live would-delete set exceeds the confirmed projection (outside_projection)
decisions.why: Cached join, Texts-only traversal and a moving lexicon can all make the preview too small; makes SC-002 hold by construction
decisions.rejected: Trust the preview; refuse the whole run on divergence

decisions.decision: Real IdleQueue with IsPaused=true, pumped by hand; one ParseFiler per word
decisions.why: UpdateWordforms is private; a declined (CanStartUow=false) batch stays in the filer queue and would be filed silently with the next word
decisions.rejected: null idle queue; single long-lived filer; reflecting on private UpdateWordforms

decisions.decision: Confirmation is unconditional for filing and bound to a plan_id (sha256 of canonical plan) issued in-session
decisions.why: manage_config can set require_write_confirmation=false and confirmed is an unverified boolean; SC-008 and FR-006 would fail
decisions.rejected: Honour require_write_confirmation for filing; bare confirmed=True

decisions.decision: Write spine in new server/filing/ package under a FILING_ROLE worker; read worker unchanged
decisions.why: Keeps FR-029 a structural fact proven by the existing no-write tests; reads go to a different process (FR-027)
decisions.rejected: Write mode inside parse/worker_main.py

decisions.decision: Extract run_module ladder rungs into server/write_ladder.py with no behaviour change
decisions.why: FR-002 forbids copies; rungs are inline in handle_run_module today
decisions.rejected: Copy the block; call handle_run_module internally

decisions.decision: Re-run the refuse-to-file gate on every grammar reload during the job
decisions.why: flexicon ParseWord silently reloads a stale grammar; a mid-run edit could otherwise file against new load errors
decisions.rejected: Gate only before the first word

decisions.decision: Port HCLoader eligibility predicates (eligible_forms_dropped signal), pinned by a live parity test
decisions.why: Predicates are private instance methods; FR-039 must name dropped entries
decisions.rejected: Reflect on the loaded Language (cannot name entries)

decisions.decision: Do not reproduce FLEx lowercase side-filing; disclose the divergence
decisions.why: It files wordforms outside the confirmed scope and projection
decisions.rejected: Reproduce ParserWorker lowercase ProcessParse

decisions.decision: Interim: on non-shared projects, release the read worker and refuse reads during filing until live L-0 proves two-process coexistence safe (maintainer decision M-1)
decisions.why: Read worker has been observed rewriting a .fwdata; a whole-file rewrite could silently revert filing
decisions.rejected: Assume coexistence is safe

decisions.decision: Keep every filing name out of server/parse/: FILING_ROLE, the filing worker module and filing_setup live in filing/client.py and register into a generic WorkerPool role registry; the read worker answers the three filing-preflight reads by delegating to filing/preflight_reads.py
decisions.why: The standing CP2b/CP3 structural tests (no filing literal, no agent probe, no write message in parse/) keep meaning what they say; parse/ stays provably read-only
decisions.rejected: Loosening those tests to allow filing names in parse/

decisions.decision: Baseline eligible_entries stores [{entry_guid, headword}] instead of bare GUIDs
decisions.why: FR-039 must NAME entries no longer eligible; a headword recorded at baseline time names a dropped entry even when it has since been deleted
decisions.rejected: [guid] only (data-model section 4) plus a headword lookup at refusal time, which cannot name a deleted entry

decisions.decision: Only read-only batch runs serve as gate baselines; filing runs never re-baseline
decisions.why: A filing run refused mid-run loaded the very grammar the gate refused; letting it re-baseline would whitewash the new errors and open a bypass. FR-021 names the read-only parse as the one escape
decisions.rejected: R-12 wording that filing runs count as baseline sources too

decisions.decision: A load whose error file could not be read, or an eligibility read that failed against a baseline that has one, refuses
decisions.why: Unknown is never clean for a gate whose failure mode is silent deletion; FLEx own HCLoadErrors.xml is never substituted (FR-023)
decisions.rejected: Treating an unreadable load as clean or as pre-existing

decisions.decision: Amend tests/test_cp1_boundary.py with a pinned CP4 allowlist: filing/filer.py may construct ParseFiler and call ProcessParse, nothing else; HCParser/XAmpleParser/ParserWorker construction and ParseWord stay forbidden outside worker_main
decisions.why: FR-018 requires filing through FieldWorks own ParseFiler, which the CP1 test forbade tree-wide; its docstring requires any widening to be justified in the test
decisions.rejected: Moving the filer call into parse/worker_main.py (puts a write into the read spine) or a blanket per-file exemption

decisions.decision: Filing persists at intervals (FLEXTOOLSMCP_FILING_SAVE_SECONDS, default 15 s) and always on filing_commit before any terminal state, rather than SaveChanges per word
decisions.why: FR-034 persist-before-success; a per-word save rewrites a whole XML-backend project each word; the record carries persisted so a crash says what may be unsaved
decisions.rejected: Save per word; save only at CloseProject

decisions.decision: Extended the HCLoader eligibility port with environment/position presence, MSA routing (stem vs rule kinds, sense-less variants) and enabled-template slot routing
decisions.why: T081 live parity on Malay found 280 vs 277: -el- (infix, no position), -kan2 and ber- (inflectional, slots only in a disabled template) drop silently in HCLoader; an over-generous port hides exactly the D-1 drops the gate exists to catch (e.g. disabling a template)
decisions.rejected: Keeping R-12 (environments taken as valid, positions logged): wrong -- IsValidRuleForm rejects a positionless infix before anything is logged

decisions.decision: Unknown is never a shield on the filer side: would_delete counts an unreadable user opinion as deletable and an unreadable segment join (in_use None) as unshielded; unknown use guards every disapproval
decisions.why: Sweep #4: reading unknown as shielded let the R-02 subset guard pass and ParseFiler delete an unconfirmed analysis with no pre_deletion capture
decisions.rejected: Adding a fourth skip reason (e.g. unreadable): SKIP_REASONS is a fixed data-model set; the existing outside_projection skip already expresses it

decisions.decision: Deferred read-worker recycle: a busy read worker at filing end is marked stale and recycled before the next filing preflight read
decisions.why: Sweep #2 HIGH: the busy-skip left previews reading a pre-filing LCM cache (R-09)
decisions.rejected: Killing the busy worker (loses a user word in flight) or leaving it (stale previews, spurious outside_projection skips)

decisions.decision: On a non-shared project the read worker is released before the writable open unconditionally (no longer gated by the M-1 flag); the flag stays True and governs only read refusals during filing
decisions.why: L-0: a writable open raises FP_FileLockedError while the read worker holds the project, so the release is required for the open to succeed at all
decisions.rejected: Dropping the interim restriction (L-0 failed) or keeping the release behind the flag (the open would fail if the flag were ever flipped)

decisions.decision: The filing worker opens with a HeadlessLcmUI subclass whose SynchronizeInvoke is SIL.LCModel.Utils.SingleThreadedSynchronizeInvoke
decisions.why: HeadlessLcmUI returns None, safe only without change subscribers; HCParser registers ParserModelChangeListener, so ParseFiler died with NRE in SendPropChangedNotifications (live)
decisions.rejected: Patching flexicon (outward; filed as a recommendation instead) or dropping the ui kwarg (FwLcmUI modal dialogs hang a headless process, flexicon #238)

decisions.decision: FR-027/SC-007 amended by the maintainer: on projects with sharing off, read-only parses and single-word tries wait for a filing run (refused with parser_filing_in_progress, hint says so); on projects with sharing on they are not blocked; run-reading tools never blocked
decisions.why: L-0: a read-only LCM open takes the project lock and a second writable open fails FP_FileLockedError on non-shared projects; shared projects coexist (S4d)
decisions.rejected: Keeping FR-027 unconditional (impossible on non-shared) or refusing reads on shared projects too (loses concurrency where it works)
